engine.name: Tasty Chips GR-1
engine.description: Tasty Chips GR-1 granular synthesizer: every setting of its manual's MIDI Command table, the control changes and the NRPN-only modulation matrix, with the value names it prints.

sources.title: GR-1 User Manual v3.4.c
sources.notes: The MIDI Command table (PDF pages 89 - 93), read by tools/profiles/tastychips/read-gr1-table.mjs from User-manual-GR-1-v3.4.c.pdf (sha256 3088f5b99534a36ede4ec846df0d4eedcede6b7b6e20d26003f46d73cdc4780f), https://www.tastychips.nl/downloads/GR-1/UserManual/User-manual-GR-1-v3.4.c.pdf, linked from https://www.tastychips.nl/gr-1-support/. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/tastychips/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/tastychips/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a CC row of the manual's MIDI Command table, on the channel variable: a row numbered 0 - 127 its control change, one above 127 its NRPN (CC 99, CC 98, then the value on CC 6), the manual's "Precision MIDI" page saying the modulation matrix "also uses CC's that are only available as NRPN". Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

An NRPN-only row's value is the 7-bit value its range prints, on CC 6 alone: the page says NRPNs take "the normal 7 bit MIDI values, but also use 14 bit values if necessary", and does not say how a printed range maps onto 14 bits. The controllers 0 - 127 with a range of 0 - 127 are also NRPNs with 14-bit values, the page says; this profile sends them as control changes.
A destination list printed only as far as `5:CUTOFF, ..` (the LFO and CV destinations, 0 - 10) is not a choice: the range is sent as a number, the list in its description.
Shown one up, as the description says the value is the number less one: Enable part, Disable part, LFO1MUL, LFO1DIV, LFO2MUL, LFO2DIV.

Left out, and named: the messages that are not settings, Pitch bend, Select patch, Note on, Note off, Clock (120), Start (122), Continue (123), Stop (124), Active sensing (125), Reset (126); MIDI's own controllers, NRPN value MSB (6), NRPN value LSB (38), NRPN Par LSB (98), NRPN Par MSB (99), RPN Par LSB (100), RPN Par MSB (101), All sound off (120), All sound off (123), OMNI off (124), OMNI on (125); the performance controllers, MOD wheel (1), MOD wheel LSB (33), Sustain pedal (64), Note pressure LSB (102), MPE timbre LSB (106); and the actions, REC(ord sample) (69).
